title: A* vs Dijkstra on a grid
sub: Same start, same goal, same wall. A* adds an estimate of the remaining distance, and explores far less.

frames.caption: Dijkstra: explore cells in order of distance from S, in every direction equally.
Reached G: shortest path length 18, after exploring 128 cells. The search spread out in every direction, including away from G.
A*: explore cells in order of distance so far + straight-line estimate to G (here, Manhattan distance).
Reached G: shortest path length 18, after exploring 44 cells. The estimate pulled the search toward G.
